The '''RSF Intelligence Division''' was the [[Intelligence (disambiguation)|intelligence]] branch of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]].<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG" />

==History==
{{Quote|I'm Sergeant Mercious Bragg of the RSF Intelligence Division. We need to find out who was behind the terrorist attack on our city before things escalate further. So far, no one has claimed responsibility.|[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Mercious Bragg|Bragg]]|<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG" />}}
[[File:Mercious.jpg|thumb|right|200px|[[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Mercious Bragg|Bragg]] of the RSF Intelligence Division]]
Following the [[Terrorist attack in Theed|terrorist attack]] in the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], Intelligence [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Mercious Bragg|Bragg]] investigated the headquarters of the four major criminal organization on Naboo, namely the [[Skaak Tippers]], [[Borvo]] the Hutt's [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|criminal empire]], the [[Darkwalkers]] and the [[Mummers]]. He discovered that the Mummers were responsible of the attack,<ref name="SWG:TtCotFMCG" /> leading to a RSF [[Raid on the Mummer bunker|raid]] on the [[Mummer bunker]].<ref name="SWG:BTttT">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Bring Terror to the Terrorists|Naboo}}</ref>
